answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the lantern graph. Re-attestations are stored in zenith and voyage lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 716 impostors cost 1803 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
